Storyboard a 30 second LinkedIn feed animation from this brief: 'Teams waste hours copying data between tools. Our connector syncs it in one click. CTA: try it free.'
expected_behavior: writes storyboard.json with version 1, fps 30, a linkedin target, and beats that carry id, duration_s, text, visual, motion and transition
first beat is the hook with on-screen text and no beat has more than 8 words
every text beat is long enough to read (at least 1.3 s and 0.35 s per word after enter, exit and overlaps)
runs the bundled validator and reports total duration, which stays within the LinkedIn feed budget
ends with a CTA beat that holds still

cases.prompt: Make a storyboard for an 8 second seamless loop that plays on a PowerPoint title slide: 'Quarterly review - Q3 2026'. No voice-over.
expected_behavior: sets loop to true and the pptx target
keeps the last beat's exit compatible with the first beat's entrance so the wrap is seamless
keeps text to a single short card that holds long enough to read
validator passes with the total duration equal to 8 seconds

cases.prompt: My storyboard.json fails validation: 'beat b3 readable hold 0.9s < required 2.1s'. Fix it without making the video longer than 30 s.
expected_behavior: explains that hold = duration minus enter, exit and transition overlaps must cover 0.35 s per word
shortens the text or rebalances durations between beats rather than blindly extending the total
re-runs the validator and shows it passing

cases.prompt: Turn this 400-word blog post into beats for a short silent animation for LinkedIn.
